name: Shisei Clinic
description: Shisei Clinic — a calm, photographic theme for a chiropractic clinic. A tall arch photograph bleeds off the left edge with a giant white BACK AT EASE wordmark across its lower edge, an oval photo with two blurred echoes, and a fixed slate pill bar for hours, access and menu, all on a slowly drifting cool slate ground. Figtree for headings, Public Sans for reading. Sample content in English first; the other four languages follow. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.
